title: Fellas Expanded Records Lab
scope: Recovered 2016–2026 Week 8 regular-season matchups, verified completed final placements 2016–2025
rules: Regular-season games and postseason are separate. The 2026 regular season is incomplete (Week 8).
ESPN scoring, rounding and PPR changed; comparing raw fantasy points across eras is descriptive, not scoring-normalized.
Career streaks mean consecutive recorded appearances, not necessarily consecutive NFL weeks. Missing matchups cannot be inferred.
Season scoring leaderboards require a completed season with at least 12 recovered regular-season games; never mix 2026 partial totals with full seasons.
Final placement achievements rely on verified official finishing ranks; 2016 had eight teams, later seasons ten. The normalized finish percentile adjusts for field size.
Rivalry rate thresholds suppress small-sample leaders. No claim is made that fantasy points allowed measures defensive skill.
An individual personal best is not necessarily a league-wide record. Highlight cards distinguish league top-three from personal records.
Tied record marks share their best competition rank (1, 1, 3), rather than being assigned arbitrary consecutive placements.

Commissioner-corrected ownership: Evans managed the 2023 season; JMid entered in 2024. All 2023 roster-slot games and finishes are credited to Evans. Historical provider handle JMidd is not manager identity.
